title: Ọbara Mbụ A Wụsara n'Anyaụfụ
intro: Chee echiche banyere ụbọchị mbụ nke ụmụ mmadụ, mgbe ụwa dum bụ otu ezinụlọ. Ị na-ekiri ka a na-enye onyinye abụọ n'ihu Allah — otu a nabatara, nke ọzọ a jụrụ. Anyaụfụ na-agbanye mkpọrọgwụ n'obi, a na-agwakwa ihe iyi egwu n'iwe. Ihe na-esote ga-ahapụ akara n'akụkọ ihe mere eme ruo mgbe ebighị ebi, ọbụna obere nnụnụ ga-aghọkwa onye nkụzi.
clues: Abụ m onye mbụ n'ezinụlọ dị n'ụwa.
Enyere m onyinye nye Allah, mana nke m anabataghị ya ebe nke ọzọ anabatara ya.
Ekwuru m okwu n'anyaụfụ ma yie m egwu igbu mmadụ.
Egburu m mmadụ mbụ n'ụwa n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi.
Ahụrụ m otu ugolo ka ọ na-akọcha ala iji gosi m otu esi ezo ozu.
M kwara ụta nke ukwuu, m wee so n'ime ndị furu efu maka ihe aka m mere.

identity.label: Ònye ka m bụ?
options: Qabil (Ken), nwa Adam
Samiri, onye na-eme nwa ehi ahụ
Namrud, onye ọchịchị aka ike nke na-arụrịta ụka na Ibrahim
Azar, onye na-eme arụsị
Kan'an, nwa Nuh nke mmiri gbawara

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Igbu nwanne ya n'ihi anyaụfụ mgbe a jụrụ onyinye ahụ
Ịrụ ụlọ elu dị elu iji lee eluigwe anya
Ịkpụ nwa ehi ọlaedo maka ofufe
Na-achọ ka e kesaa tebụl site n'eluigwe
Idu ndị agha enyí iji bibie Kaaba
trial.answer: Igbu nwanne ya n'ihi anyaụfụ mgbe a jụrụ onyinye ahụ

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Ugolo na-akọcha ụwa iji gosi ili ya
Nwa ehi ọlaedo nke dara ada
Ụgbọ ukwu dị n'elu mmiri idei mmiri
Mkpanaka nke ghọrọ agwọ
Tebụl e tinyere nri sitere n'eluigwe n'elu tebụl
location.answer: Ugolo na-akọcha ụwa iji gosi ili ya

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Aghọọla onye na-akwa ụta ma sonye n'ime ndị furu efu
E riri ya n'oké idei mmiri ahụ
Ala loro ya na akụ
E tiri m ekpenta ruo afọ asaa
E nyere ya alaeze nke nwere ike ịchịkwa ifufe
outcome.answer: Aghọọla onye na-akwa ụta ma sonye n'ime ndị furu efu

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
